02 / Artist profile

NOT ONE
LANE.

D-BAG is the independent electronic-music project of Daniel Frias, moving between percussion-led tech house, UK garage, house, bass-heavy club music and Latin influences.

The sound shifts from track to track: sometimes stripped-back and rhythm-first, sometimes more melodic, sometimes built for a packed room. The throughline is groove and energy—not one formula.
